title: David Lowery
description: Luke's levitated POV, in the midst of his Jedi training on Dagobah. "Beyond the inspiration of the STAR WARS movie trilogy, THE ART OF STAR WARS books really sent me into orbit," reveals David Lowery. "[These creations] continue to stand as the high-water mark of what artistic vision can bring to movies." Lowery began his film illustration career at George Lucas' famed Industrial Light and Magic, storyboarding WILLOW. His recent film credits include JURASSIC PARK, BRAM STOKER'S DRACULA, HOOK, THE FLINTSTONES, and THE ROCKETEER.
